# Advanced Analytics for College Baseball

The **College Baseball Explorer** is an interactive resource for exploring college baseball statistics and advanced analytics. Built with publicly available college baseball data curated from Sports Reference and enhanced with advanced sabermetric calculations, the Explorer provides tools for analyzing player and team performance across seasons. 

Explore college baseball performance through interactive visualizations, advanced metrics, percentile rankings, and downloadable data spanning seasons from 2011 to the present. 

This project was created to make advanced college baseball analytics more accessible. By providing transparent methodology, interactive tools, and freely available data, the College Baseball Explorer helps fans, analysts, coaches, and researchers better understand player and team performance.

The **College Baseball Explorer** provides a centralized resource for analyzing conference performance from 2011-present using metrics including:

- **wRC+** — adjusted offensive production
- **wOBA** — overall offensive value
- **ISO** — power production
- **FIP** — fielding-independent pitching performance
- **K-BB%** — strikeout-to-walk differential
